description: This file defines the UnixSocketConnectionListener class, which implements a socket-based connection listener for Unix domain sockets within the Orleans testing host environment. It manages socket binding, accepting connections asynchronously, and proper disposal of resources.

classes.name: UnixSocketConnectionListener
classes.description: Implements a Unix domain socket listener that accepts incoming connections asynchronously, manages socket lifecycle, and integrates with Orleans testing infrastructure.

methods.name: UnixSocketConnectionListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the socket listener with endpoint, options, trace, and schedulers.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to the Unix domain socket endpoint and starts listening.

methods.name: AcceptAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously accepts incoming socket connections, handling exceptions and connection resets.

methods.name: UnbindAsync
methods.description: Disposes the socket and memory pool resources asynchronously, effectively unbinding the listener.
